pages.raw_title: Who We Are - CVR Partners, LP
pages.raw_meta: CVR Partners is a growth-oriented company focused on producing nitrogen fertilizer to help serve the needs of a growing population
raw_blocks: Annual Report & Proxy Information
Reaching Out to Our Communities
Product and Safety Data Sheets

We are a growth-oriented limited partnership formed by CVR Energy, Inc., to own, operate and grow our nitrogen fertilizer business. Our nitrogen fertilizer manufacturing facilities, which primarily produce ammonia and urea ammonium nitrate (UAN) fertilizers, are located in Coffeyville, Kansas, and East Dubuque, Illinois.

Our Coffeyville plant is the only such operations in North America that uses a petroleum coke gasification process to make hydrogen, a key ingredient in its manufacturing process. Our East Dubuque nitrogen fertilizer plant uses natural gas as its feedstock to produce nitrogen fertilizer. In 2025, our fertilizer facilities produced a combined 761,000 tons of ammonia, of which 243,000 net tons were available for sale, while the rest was upgraded to other fertilizer products, including 1,174,000 tons of UAN.
CVR Partners, LP is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "UAN." CVR Energy subsidiaries serve as the general partner and own 37 percent of the common units of CVR Partners.
